newsitem.title: FINLAND: LASSILA & TIKANOJA SEES HIGHER 1997 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LASSILA & TIKANOJA SEES HIGHER 1997 PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish plastic and cleaning equipment group Lassila & Tikanoja Oy said on Wednesday it expected earnings to improve further this year.
"The group's earnings are expected to improve further," it said in a statement with its 1996 results.
"The largest (profit) increases are expected from JWS and Sakkivaline," Lassila & Tikanoja said.
Inka's earnings would also improve while Amerplast's earnings were expected to remain at last year's level, it said.
In 1996, Lassila & Tikanoja's profit before extras and tax rose 41 percent to 154 million markka.
